name: .MD this page
description: Turn any webpage into clean, LLM-ready Markdown in one click.
atGlance: Convert any webpage to clean Markdown instantly with one click or keyboard shortcut.
fullDescription: .MD this page is a Chrome extension that extracts the main content of any webpage, removes clutter, and converts it into well-formatted Markdown. Built for developers, writers, and AI enthusiasts who need to feed web content into LLMs or capture it as structured notes. Powered by Mozilla Readability and Turndown for high-quality output.

coreFeatures.name: One-Click Conversion
coreFeatures.description: Convert any webpage to Markdown instantly via right-click menu or Alt+M keyboard shortcut.

coreFeatures.name: Smart Content Extraction
coreFeatures.description: Uses Mozilla Readability to isolate the main article content and strip navigation, ads, and clutter.

coreFeatures.name: Configurable Output
coreFeatures.description: Toggle images, links, metadata, and URLs to customize the Markdown output to your needs.

coreFeatures.name: Multiple Export Options
coreFeatures.description: Copy to clipboard, save as a file, or generate LLM-optimized prompt strings.

additionalFeatures.name: Preview Panel
additionalFeatures.description: Review the generated Markdown in a dedicated side panel before copying or saving.

additionalFeatures.name: Open Source
additionalFeatures.description: Fully open source under MIT license, built with Plasmo, React, and Tailwind CSS.

name: uBlock Origin
description: Finally, an efficient blocker. Easy on CPU and memory.
atGlance: An efficient content blocker that is easy on CPU and memory.
fullDescription: uBlock Origin is an efficient, wide-spectrum content blocker for Chromium and Firefox. It blocks ads, trackers, coin miners, popups, and malware domains. Unlike other blockers, uBlock Origin is optimized to use less CPU and memory while being just as effective at blocking content.

coreFeatures.name: Ad Blocking
coreFeatures.description: Blocks advertisements on all websites for a cleaner browsing experience.

coreFeatures.name: Tracker Protection
coreFeatures.description: Prevents trackers from monitoring your browsing activity.

coreFeatures.name: CPU and Memory Efficient
coreFeatures.description: Optimized to use significantly less CPU and memory than other blockers.

additionalFeatures.name: Element Picker
additionalFeatures.description: Manually select and hide any element on a page with the element picker tool.

additionalFeatures.name: Dynamic Filtering
additionalFeatures.description: Fine-grained control over which scripts and frames are allowed per site.

additionalFeatures.name: Malware Domain Filtering
additionalFeatures.description: Protects against known malware and phishing domains.

name: Scribbr Citation Generator
description: Instantly get accurate citations for any webpage in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and any other style.
atGlance: Generate accurate citations for webpages directly from Chrome.
fullDescription: Scribbr Citation Generator is a Chrome extension for students, teachers, and researchers that creates reference list entries and in-text citations for online sources. It supports APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and other styles, extracts key sentences with citations, and can generate page summaries for quick review.

coreFeatures.name: Multi-Style Citations
coreFeatures.description: Generates accurate citations for webpages in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and other styles.

coreFeatures.name: In-Page Research Workflow
coreFeatures.description: Creates reference list entries and in-text citations while browsing online sources.

coreFeatures.name: Key Sentence Extraction
coreFeatures.description: Extracts important sentences from a page with proper citation support.

coreFeatures.name: Page Summaries
coreFeatures.description: Generates concise summaries of webpages to speed up research review.

additionalFeatures.name: Chrome Web Store Installation
additionalFeatures.description: Installed directly from the Chrome Web Store as a browser extension.

additionalFeatures.name: Copy to Clipboard
additionalFeatures.description: Copies generated citations quickly into papers, notes, or documents.

additionalFeatures.name: No Ads
additionalFeatures.description: Designed as a free citation workflow without ads in the extension experience.

name: Eye Dropper
atGlance: Pick colors from any website with a precise eyedropper tool.
fullDescription: Eye Dropper is a Chrome extension that lets you pick colors from any webpage using a precise eyedropper tool. It captures the exact color value and provides the hex code, RGB values, and other color formats. It includes a color history and a palette manager for collecting colors during design work.

coreFeatures.name: Precision Eyedropper
coreFeatures.description: Pick any color on screen with pixel-level precision.

coreFeatures.name: Color Format Support
coreFeatures.description: View and copy colors in HEX, RGB, HSL, and other formats.

coreFeatures.name: Color History
coreFeatures.description: Automatically saves a history of all picked colors for reference.

additionalFeatures.name: Palette Collection
additionalFeatures.description: Organize picked colors into named palettes for projects.

additionalFeatures.name: Zoom Loupe
additionalFeatures.description: Magnified view around the cursor for accurate color selection.

name: uBlock Origin Lite
description: An efficient content blocker. Blocks ads, trackers, miners, and more immediately upon installation.
atGlance: A lightweight Manifest V3 content blocker that blocks ads, trackers, and miners.
fullDescription: uBlock Origin Lite is a Manifest V3-compatible version of uBlock Origin. It blocks ads, trackers, cryptominers, and other unwanted content across the web. Built from the ground up for Manifest V3, it provides the same blocking power as uBlock Origin with a focus on the new extension platform.

coreFeatures.name: Ad and Tracker Blocking
coreFeatures.description: Blocks ads, trackers, and cryptominers immediately upon installation.

coreFeatures.name: Manifest V3 Native
coreFeatures.description: Built specifically for Manifest V3 with declarative net request rules.

coreFeatures.name: Minimal Permissions
coreFeatures.description: Requires minimal permissions compared to other ad blockers.

additionalFeatures.name: Dynamic Filter Lists
additionalFeatures.description: Uses declarative filter lists that update automatically.

additionalFeatures.name: Privacy First
additionalFeatures.description: No user data is collected or transmitted by the extension.

name: GoFullPage - Full Page Screen Capture
description: Capture a screenshot of your current page in entirety and reliably—without requesting any extra permissions!
atGlance: Capture full-page screenshots of any website reliably and without extra permissions.
fullDescription: GoFullPage captures a screenshot of your entire current page in one click, from top to bottom. It stitches the full page together seamlessly without requesting any extra permissions beyond what is needed to run. The captured screenshot can be downloaded as a PNG or PDF.

coreFeatures.name: One-Click Full Page Capture
coreFeatures.description: Capture an entire webpage from top to bottom with a single click.

coreFeatures.name: No Extra Permissions
coreFeatures.description: Works without requesting any additional permissions beyond basic functionality.

coreFeatures.name: Download as PNG or PDF
coreFeatures.description: Save the captured full-page screenshot as PNG image or PDF document.

additionalFeatures.name: Visible Viewport Capture
additionalFeatures.description: Also supports capturing only the visible portion of the page.

additionalFeatures.name: Screenshot History
additionalFeatures.description: Access your recently captured screenshots from the extension popup.

name: WhatFont
description: The easiest way to identify fonts on web pages.
atGlance: Identify fonts used on any web page with a single click.
fullDescription: WhatFont is the easiest way to identify fonts on web pages. Hover over any text element to see the font name, size, weight, color, and line height. It supports Google Fonts, Typekit, and custom web fonts, making it an essential tool for designers and developers.

coreFeatures.name: Font Identification
coreFeatures.description: Hover over any text to instantly identify the font family being used.

coreFeatures.name: Font Details
coreFeatures.description: View font size, weight, color, line height, and other CSS properties.

coreFeatures.name: Type Service Detection
coreFeatures.description: Detects if the font is from Google Fonts, Typekit, or other services.

additionalFeatures.name: Copy to Clipboard
additionalFeatures.description: Copy font name and details to clipboard for design documentation.

additionalFeatures.name: WhatFont Toolbar
additionalFeatures.description: Toggle the tool on and off from a convenient toolbar button.

name: Clear Cache
description: Powerful, user-friendly browser data management, right from your toolbar.
atGlance: Clear your browser cache, storage, and cookies with one click from the toolbar.
fullDescription: Clear Cache provides powerful and user-friendly browser data management right from your toolbar. With a single click, you can clear various types of browser data including cache, cookies, local storage, session storage, and more. It offers granular control over what gets cleared and supports keyboard shortcuts for power users.

coreFeatures.name: One-Click Clearing
coreFeatures.description: Clear browser data with a single click from the toolbar icon.

coreFeatures.name: Granular Control
coreFeatures.description: Select exactly which data types to clear — cache, cookies, storage, and more.

coreFeatures.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
coreFeatures.description: Assign and use keyboard shortcuts for instant cache clearing.

additionalFeatures.name: Clear on Page Load
additionalFeatures.description: Optionally clear selected data automatically when pages load.

additionalFeatures.name: Notifications
additionalFeatures.description: Get a confirmation notification after data has been cleared.

name: Imageye - Image Downloader
description: Find and download all images on a web page with Image downloader.
atGlance: Find and download all images on any web page with one click.
fullDescription: Imageye is a powerful image downloader browser extension that lets you find, browse, and download all images displayed on any web page. It scans the page for all image elements and presents them in a clean gallery view, allowing you to select and download the images you want.

coreFeatures.name: Bulk Image Detection
coreFeatures.description: Automatically detects and lists all images on the current web page.

coreFeatures.name: Gallery Preview
coreFeatures.description: Displays images in a gallery view for easy browsing and selection.

coreFeatures.name: Batch Download
coreFeatures.description: Select multiple images and download them all at once.

additionalFeatures.name: Filter by Size
additionalFeatures.description: Filter images by minimum width and height to find the best quality.

additionalFeatures.name: Image Format Info
additionalFeatures.description: Shows image format, dimensions, and file size for each image.

name: Video DownloadHelper
description: Detect and download videos and audio from over 1,000 websites with format conversion support.
atGlance: Detect, download, and convert video and audio from thousands of websites.
fullDescription: Video DownloadHelper is a powerful extension that detects and downloads video and audio content from over 1,000 websites. It supports multiple streaming protocols including DASH, HLS, and MPD, and can handle live streaming content. The built-in conversion engine lets you transform downloaded media into popular formats such as MP4, MKV, WebM, and MP3 for audio extraction.

coreFeatures.name: Broad Website Support
coreFeatures.description: Detects and downloads media from over 1,000 websites with wide protocol compatibility.

coreFeatures.name: Format Conversion
coreFeatures.description: Convert downloaded videos to MP4, MKV, WebM, and extract audio to MP3.

coreFeatures.name: Streaming Protocol Support
coreFeatures.description: Handles DASH, HLS, and MPD streaming protocols including live streams.

additionalFeatures.name: Audio Extraction
additionalFeatures.description: Extract audio from videos and save as MP3 for offline listening or podcast creation.

additionalFeatures.name: Download Queue
additionalFeatures.description: Manage multiple downloads simultaneously with a built-in queue manager.

similarTools.name: Video Downloader Professional
similarTools.description: Alternative video downloader with watchlist and download management features.

name: Video Downloader Professional
description: Download videos from web sites or just collect them in your video list without downloading them.
atGlance: Download videos from any website or collect them in a watchlist.
fullDescription: Video Downloader Professional lets you detect and download videos playing on web pages. You can download videos directly or add them to a personal video list to watch later without downloading immediately. It supports a wide range of video formats and streaming sources.

coreFeatures.name: Video Detection
coreFeatures.description: Automatically detects video content on any web page you visit.

coreFeatures.name: Direct Download
coreFeatures.description: Download detected videos in various formats and qualities.

coreFeatures.name: Video Watchlist
coreFeatures.description: Collect videos in a list for later viewing without downloading them.

additionalFeatures.name: Format Selection
additionalFeatures.description: Choose from available video formats and quality levels before downloading.

additionalFeatures.name: Download Management
additionalFeatures.description: Monitor and manage active and completed downloads from the extension popup.

name: 3D Mview Extractor
atGlance: Detect and extract 3D Mview files from web pages.
fullDescription: 3D Mview Extractor is a specialized browser extension that detects and extracts 3D Mview files embedded in web pages. It enables users to download 3D model files for offline use and further processing.

coreFeatures.name: 3D File Detection
coreFeatures.description: Automatically detects 3D Mview files embedded in the current page.

coreFeatures.name: File Extraction
coreFeatures.description: Extracts detected 3D files and makes them available for download.

coreFeatures.name: Format Support
coreFeatures.description: Supports common 3D Mview file formats used on the web.

additionalFeatures.name: Simple Interface
additionalFeatures.description: Clean popup interface showing all detected 3D files at a glance.
